title: Wide Toe Box Knit Slip-On Casual Shoes with Sculpted EVA Sole and Rear Pull Loop for Footwear Collections
highlights:

Room for the forefoot: The wider toe design gives the toes more space at the front of the shoe for everyday walking.

Simple daily dressing: The slip-on opening removes the need to tie conventional laces when putting the shoes on.

A grip for entry: The pull loop provides a place to hold the shoe while guiding the foot into the opening.
